lastCompletedStory.title: /cam-plan spec-sourcing by specSource + honest non-grilled signal

nextStoryContext: US-003 replaced the stage:idea D2 warning in /cam-plan Step 2 (none backend, integer arg) with specSource-driven spec sourcing: specSource=grill (or absent) uses the spec field verbatim (do-not-re-litigate); specSource=derived/operator uses title+description as proposed scope and prints a non-grilled signal, passing derivedFrom to the subagent-planner. Step 7 prompt now includes Spec(specSource) and derivedFrom fields. subagent-planner.md gained a Spec Sourcing section instructing it to read derivedFrom parent issues when specSource is derived. Both .claude/ and templates/ copies were updated (wording deltas preserved). src/vendor/_generated.ts was regenerated. Dual-copy pattern: .claude has bun-specific commands (bun run typecheck, bun test) while templates uses generic phrasing; the Spec Sourcing section is verbatim in .claude but omits cam-specific file paths (scripts/cam/issues/*.json) in templates. US-004 is next: ADR documenting the two-door plan-readiness decision.

officialDocsValidated.summary: All changes are in markdown instruction files (.claude/commands/cam-plan.md, templates/commands/cam-plan.md, .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md, templates/agents/subagent-planner.md) and the generated src/vendor/_generated.ts. No external library API was exercised.
